title: Warm Pool
definition: A warm pool is an extensive region of the tropical ocean whose surface waters stay warmer than a threshold temperature, and the threshold depends on the source.[^1][^2] NOAA Climate.gov describes the Indo-Pacific Warm Pool as a region where sea surface temperatures remain above 28°C year-round, while NOAA AOML defines both warm pools as the region where sea surface temperature exceeds 28.5°C.[^2][^1]
